archive.label: Archive Quality — Ada/Blackwell NVENC
archive.evidenceNote: A measured starting point; quality and size vary by scene. Ada support is documented and capability-gated; local benchmark evidence applies to Blackwell only. CRF and CQ numbers are not equivalent.

descriptions.label: H264 · CPU
descriptions.presetHelp: Slower CPU presets allow more encoding effort for compression efficiency; faster presets prioritize speed. A preset is separate from CRF and does not promise a particular file size or equal quality across encoders.
descriptions.qualityHelp: CRF is this encoder's quality-based rate control. Lower values generally request higher quality and larger files. CRF values are not quality-equivalent across encoders or interchangeable with NVIDIA CQ.
descriptions.mediaNote: These are the deterministic video-encoder options, not a complete command. Preparation resolves stream mapping, preserved metadata, pixel format/bit depth, hardware codec profile, color, provenance and input/output paths from each inspected file.

descriptions.qualityHelp: CQ is the NVENC target quality in the current VBR mode with no target bitrate. Lower values generally request higher quality and larger files. CQ and CPU CRF numbers are not quality-equivalent, nor are equal values across codecs.
descriptions.mediaNote: These are the deterministic video-encoder options, not a complete command. Preparation resolves stream mapping, preserved metadata, pixel format/bit depth, hardware codec profile, color, provenance and input/output paths from each inspected file.
